title: Act: Scaffold backend Go Chi module and YAML config
summary: Create root go.mod, Chi /healthz router, LoadFS YAML config, and example YAML.
description:
Context: No Go backend exists at tip.
Desired behavior: Add root Go module with config.LoadFS and NewRouter GET /healthz.
Expected result: Root builds as a Go module with example YAML; config load uses fs.FS.
Why: Implements REQ-BE product code only.
acceptance_criteria: Given Act complete, when inspecting root paths, then go.mod, main.go, config.go, router.go, and config.example.yaml exist.
Given LoadFS reading example-shaped YAML, when called, then Addr and RepoPath fields populate from YAML keys server.addr and git.repo_path.
technical_constraints: Config load API must accept fs.FS
definition_of_done: No test files added by this Act

steps.action: Create go.mod with module path github.com/storyforge/worldseed, go 1.22, requiring github.com/go-chi/chi/v5 and gopkg.in/yaml.v3.
steps.code:
module github.com/storyforge/worldseed

go 1.22

require (
        github.com/go-chi/chi/v5 v5.1.0
        gopkg.in/yaml.v3 v3.0.1
)
steps.expected: go.mod declares Chi and YAML dependencies.

steps.action: Create package main with structs Config, ServerConfig{Addr string `yaml:"addr"`}, GitConfig{RepoPath string `yaml:"repo_path"`}; Config has Server and Git fields with yaml tags server/git. Export LoadFS(fsys fs.FS, name string) (*Config, error) that opens name via fsys.Open, decodes YAML into Config, returns error if open/decode fails or Server.Addr is empty.
steps.expected: LoadFS decodes YAML from an fs.FS file and validates addr.

steps.action: Create package main exporting NewRouter() http.Handler that returns chi.NewRouter with Get /healthz writing status 200 and body ok.

Create main that reads optional -config flag default config.example.yaml, loads via LoadFS(os.DirFS("."), path), prints Addr and RepoPath to stdout, and notes router wiring via _ = NewRouter() so the package is linked without listening (Phase-1 stub — do not call ListenAndServe).
steps.expected: main loads YAML config and links Chi router without binding a live port.

steps.action: Create example YAML with server.addr :8080 and git.repo_path .
steps.expected: Example backend YAML documents addr and repo_path.
